summary.intent: Have the assistant follow the project rule that findings get resolved as soon as the fix is made, then confirm that the enum fix commit was pushed to the remote.
summary.outcome: The #291 enum finding was resolved with citations to #504, commits 22baa273 and 3ef0ee62, and tests, and the memory note was updated. The push was confirmed: 3ef0ee62 is on origin/fix/enum-unknown-member-values, with a merge commit 9fdcab1f from someone else on top.

repo: Findings are resolved when the fix lands, citing the PR, commits and tests, and this includes fixes made on a different branch than the finding.
Resolving a finding with `--trail caliper/N` alone works; adding `--branch` fails.
Remote branch fix/enum-unknown-member-values has a 'Merge branch main' commit (9fdcab1f) that was not pushed locally. It is probably Entire's update-branch step, but this was not confirmed.
Merging changes needs `just semver` and `/code-review medium` run on the PR, plus CI and Entire review.
workflow: Save recurring user corrections as a memory note and update it with each new case; the note resolve-findings-when-fixed.md already existed and the assistant still broke the rule.
Verify the push by checking the remote head and whether it contains the local commit as an ancestor, rather than assuming.
Pull before any further push when the remote has moved ahead of the local branch.

friction: The assistant forgot to resolve the finding after fixing it, despite an existing memory note, so the user had to remind them again.
The assistant used an incorrect flag combination (`--trail` with `--branch`) when resolving the finding.
The remote branch gained a merge commit from outside the local session, leaving the local branch one commit behind.
open_items: #504 still needs CI and Entire review, and `just semver` and `/code-review medium` have not been run.
#490 is green with its #288 findings resolved; the acceptance run is held until the user decides whether to run it before merge.
Changes 8 and 7, and D (the Chakra `declined` guard), have not been started.
Pull the remote merge commit 9fdcab1f into local enum-unknown-followup before any further push, and confirm where it came from and what main brought in.
